The term "420" is widely believed to have originated from a group of high school students in San Rafael, California, in the early 1970s. These students, known as the "Waldos," would meet at 4:20 pm after school to search for a rumored abandoned cannabis crop. They used "420" as a code for their meeting time and, by extension, for marijuana itself. This story is well-documented and is the most accepted origin of the term.

The other options, such as police codes or the origin being unknown, are common myths or misconceptions. There is no official police code "420" related to marijuana in Los Angeles or elsewhere.

Answer: A
